contracts.name: conversation-suspense

contracts.limits: su/ut predicates and real prefetch data provider remain unresolved

contracts.offline_requirement: Implement 4 explicit read-only returns, log every call; never expose real account/session data
contracts.limits: Synthetic Sentry options in replay are not a complete official schema
